newer_changes_search: Web search for 2025-2026 PMGKAY/NFSA changes: free foodgrains continue for five years from 1 Jan 2024 (to Dec 2028). DFPD published a draft National Food Security (Amendment) Bill, 2026 in June 2026 (comments to 13 Jul 2026) that would change AAY to 7 kg per person capped at 35 kg per household; secondary reports only, no PIB release, and it is not enacted. The source note already records this. No change needed now; re-check when the Bill is introduced/passed.

findings.note: aadhaar cites cabinet_2023, which does not mention Aadhaar. how_to_apply's 'Aadhaar with fingerprint' is also not in the cited Cabinet note. The NFSA Act s.12(2)(c) ('leveraging aadhaar for unique identification, with biometric information') supports it loosely.
findings.suggestion: Change the aadhaar document source to nfsa_act (or an ONORC/DFPD page that describes Aadhaar biometric authentication at fair price shops).

findings.note: Logic is correct (PMGKAY is only for NFSA AAY/PHH card holders). Source is the Act (gazette), confidence 'guidance' is conservative and acceptable because the card is a proxy for being an identified household.
If the NFS (Amendment) Bill 2026 is enacted, the AAY 35 kg per household wording will change to 7 kg per person (max 35 kg).
findings.suggestion: Set reverify_days lower (e.g. 90) while the Bill is pending.
